api_doc_gaps.detail: SVC-API · second-agent review 2026-10-01: (i) in-process VersionNotFoundException/ConnectionNotFoundException carry no code BY DESIGN (ADR-REG-011 (2); registry-exec-be-reg.md counts one in-process code) — resolved; STILL OPEN, no rule/code/message exists for: (e) malformed service.yaml, (f) a definition missing version/input/a query's sql or connection or version < 1, (g) an activation entry missing name/endpoint/dialect/credential reference, an mcp entry without query tool, or a blank environment-name while entries are listed, (h) a persistence failure of one item after its rules passed · interim: (e)(f) rejected under RULE-REG-012 with element 'malformed: <detail>' / 'missing: <path>' / 'invalid: <path>'; (g) rejected PER ENTRY as a CONNECTION Load Result row with a plain-English reason and no code (REQ-REG-007, ADR-REG-015, ADR-REG-022), blank environment-name refuses every entry; (h) fails the run with REG-500 although REG-500 is an HTTP-only catalog code (ADR-REG-011) — the factory is asked for a load reason code for each

A request with an Accept header the endpoint cannot produce (e.g. text/plain) answers REG-500 because the error catalog has no 406/400 code for it; INT maps the same case to INT-400-REQUEST-INVALID. The factory is asked for a code (406 or 400) to add to the REG error-catalog and API document.
